name: Zuinamia Netesutasu
original_name: ズイナミア・ネテスタス
source: She is the head of the Netestas family, which holds the rank of Viscount in the Kingdom of Belgarad. While searching for something to do to stave off boredom, she met Geary, a member of the family of the "魔シキ封錬の匠" who was expelled from the Kingdom of Influs after a conflict with the Fiushia Church. She was fascinated by Geary's ideals and her passionate way of life and offered to help and support her. In return for her help, she aims to obtain something that will benefit the Kingdom of Belgarad, but she is more interested in how Geary lives her life and how she rebels against the world. She seems to feel happiest above all else in being involved in her passionate way of life. She has strict values that do not tolerate failure in anything, as she and others acknowledge, but she is very kind to those she trusts. However, the only person she trusts at the moment is Geary.
